events.text: Grade mode landed (685d7eb8d): roads now smooth the painted terrain under their bed on every stamp — longitudinal moving-average profile (irons potholes, keeps climbs), zero crossfall curb-to-curb, 3-tile feathered shoulders. Pure + tested (roadGrade 4/4), wired in restampRoads with heightDirty so the 3D drape and colliders follow. Deck/approach-strips/tunnel modes remain.

resolution: Closed the visible half now rather than waiting for the micro-grid (commit 473e83f86): the ribbon section header gained laneStart/median kind indices, and any road-stamped cell (lane/median/junction) whose fragment falls OUTSIDE the analytic band now renders as a concrete curb apron instead of the blocky asphalt staircase — the exact artifact visible in the user's screenshot at curve edges. Look-layer only: the 1m gameplay stamps are untouched, so when the micro-grid later tightens the stamped footprint around the ribbon, this apron simply shrinks with it — the two compose. Both road suites green (22/22 + 3/3), cart bundles clean, hot-reloads. The FLOOR 3x3 micro-grid itself (paintable per-cell kinds on pieces, prop footprint auto-stamping, road decks) remains the next major slice on the task board — it wants a fresh session paired with the host surface-nav design since pathing-on-floors is its real consumer.
